annotations.title: Save an edit to a work draft

description: Persist one authored edit with the exact base from the last result you showed the owner, a stable clientRequestId, the slot and the new draft. Keep original IDs across transport loss. On conflict retain the authored bytes and reconcile the returned current draft with soclo_work_drafts_read; never refresh the base invisibly or overwrite another client’s edit. A null draft is an explicit clear, not an expiry. Saving work starts no generation, publication or charge.
name: soclo_work_drafts_edit
title: Save an edit to a work draft
